summary: Re-verified the ITEM_LABELS crash fix on the doctor pages (frontend only, 390x844 mobile viewport, logged in as Dr. Aisha Patel). /doctor/active loads with no red screen and no pageerror. Ran the full active flow on an existing accepted visit (TEST_P_116579): Start trip -> I have arrived -> Mark completed. The dispense modal listed all 8 kit items by label (Paracetamol 500mg, Ibuprofen 400mg, Amoxicillin 500mg, ORS Sachets, Cetirizine 10mg, Antiseptic Kit, Digital Thermometer, Bandage Roll). Picked 1 Paracetamol and tapped End Visit: the alert 'Visit closed. Tri-party reconciliation complete.' appeared, the page showed 'No active jobs' and the kit went from Paracetamol x10 to x9. /doctor/inventory shows the kit item names. The mock QR Restock (store-*) checked out a kit from Indiranagar Hub and refreshed it. The wastage modal shows the item labels. Doctor feed loads (0 cards while a visit was active, which is the expected sequential lock, then 9 pending cards after it closed). Only one doctorFeed method is left in api.ts. tsc shows no errors in active.tsx, inventory.tsx or api.ts. Fix verified.

issues: The qty +/- buttons (styles.qtyBtn) are 30x30, below the 44x44 minimum touch target. They also have no testIDs.
The 'Log' button text sits at the top of the button instead of being vertically centred. It also looks taller than the Cancel button.

action_items: Optional: make the dispense qty buttons at least 44x44 and add testIDs (e.g. dispense-plus-{id} / dispense-minus-{id}).
Optional: vertically centre the text in the wastage modal 'Log' button (confirm-wastage) and match its height to Cancel.
critical_code_review_comments: ITEM_LABELS is now exported from src/lib/api.ts and imported in active.tsx and inventory.tsx. Both files fall back to the raw id with ITEM_LABELS[id] || id.
api.ts reads process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. That is correct for Expo, and the frontend .env defines it.
seed_data_creation: None created. Data changed during testing: completed the pre-existing TEST_P_116579 visit (8123da88...) with 1 Paracetamol dispensed. Re-checked out doc-1's kit from the first store (Indiranagar Hub), which consumes that dark store's stock (seeded app data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Doctor doc-1 (Dr. Aisha Patel) has no active visit now, so the feed shows pending requests. The kit is bound to Indiranagar Hub. The mock QR button (qr-scan-button) only appears when there is no kit; otherwise use rescan-button.
rca_of_issue: ITEM_LABELS was declared only in inventory.tsx but used in active.tsx for the dispense modal, which caused a ReferenceError. Moving it to the shared api.ts module and importing it in both files fixed the crash; verified via UI.
